author: zhenbinwu
body:
#### PR description:

In previous PRs, the KMTF firmware was updated to use Z and slope information for barrel muon stubs, reusing the bits originally assigned to the stubs' eta1 and eta2 fields. However, porting these changes to the emulator introduced a bug affecting TPS stubs, as reported in [CMSSW issue #52096](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/52096). This PR fixes the issue.

For SAMuon ghost busting, we updated the algorithm to use stub IDs/addresses instead of object pointers. This change follows the intended design and prevents potential issues when ghost busting KMTF and OMTF muons.

A KMTF muon is associated with a KMTF stub, which is subsequently converted into a TPS stub for use by OMTF. Although the KMTF stub and its corresponding TPS stub represent the same underlying stub, they may have different object pointers while retaining the same address. Using stub IDs/addresses instead of pointers allows the ghost-busting algorithm to correctly identify these cases and avoid missing matches due to differences in object pointers.


#### PR validation:

It recovered the tkMuon efficiency in the barrel region.
title: [L1GMT]  Fix stub of Barrel Muon KMTF
